Hi Maria — thanks for the heads-up and the proposed time. Quick note on the DST situation: US (ET) falls back one hour on Sun Nov 1 at 02:00 local time, so a Nov 2 slot will appear shifted by one hour for any US calendar entries created before/after that change unless you anchor by UTC. New Zealand will already be on NZDT (+13) by that date, so that side is stable.

To avoid confusion we usually do one of two things:
- Pick a fixed UTC time and list local equivalents in the invite, or
- Offer two nearby slots and confirm which timezone baseline attendees will use.

Can you confirm whether Daniel / the US execs prefer their local pre-change time (i.e., as if DST were still in effect) or the post-change hour? If it's helpful I can propose two concrete slot options with UTC anchors and a short timezone cheat-sheet attached.

I'll attach a quick timezone chart and an agenda draft — please flag required attendees so we can lock something.

Best,
Hiro
